query: INSERT INTO releases (entity_id,version,released_at,eol_at,lts,source_id) SELECT $1,version,released::date,eol::date,lts,$2 FROM UNNEST($3::text[],$4::text[],$5::text[],$6::bool[]) AS r(version,released,eol,lts) ON CONFLICT (entity_id,version,source_id) DO UPDATE SET released_at=EXCLUDED.released_at,eol_at=EXCLUDED.eol_at,lts=EXCLUDED.lts
